tools.name: execute_sql
tools.purpose: Execute one Presto or Spark SQL statement.
tools.safety: Record rid for long jobs. Do not retry by submitting a duplicate before checking status.

tools.name: get_query_status
tools.purpose: Check a query's state and progress by rid.
tools.safety: Status polling is not a result download.

tools.name: get_query_result
tools.purpose: Download a query result after checking its size.
tools.safety: Preferred download tool; default cap is 500 MB.

tools.name: download_query_result_raw
tools.purpose: Download a result without size checking.
tools.safety: Only for known-size, explicitly authorized downloads; memory and timeout risk.

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.purpose: Generate a short-lived authenticated download URL.
tools.safety: Do not persist signed URLs or returned authentication headers.

tools.name: get_latest_partitions
tools.purpose: Inspect the latest partitions for a table.
tools.safety: Actual coverage must be checked before time-window conclusions.

tools.name: get_table_ddl
tools.safety: Use the returned full_name in SQL instead of guessing the catalog.

tools.name: get_table_metadata
tools.safety: Metadata is semantic evidence, not proof of current units or coverage.

tools.name: query_data_lineage
tools.purpose: Query upstream or downstream Lighthouse lineage.
tools.safety: Use lineage as relationship evidence, not as field-definition proof.

tools.name: get_task_detail
tools.purpose: Inspect a Lighthouse task and its read/write dependencies.
tools.safety: Read-only inspection; do not modify production jobs.

tools.name: query_event_data
tools.purpose: Inspect Doris event-tracking definitions by product or event.
tools.safety: Confirm event scope; this is a definition lookup, not a user-level behavior extraction.
